rail.signal.removed_area: Babu alama a gaban {area}: an cire alamar da aka samar a can. Ba a tsayar da jiragen ƙasa kafin {area}, don haka ɗaya na iya shiga cikin jirgin da ke ketare shi. Sake saita alamomi, ko sanya alama a gefen {area}.
rail.signal.removed_block: An cire alamar sashe: sashen ya girma zuwa {block} inda {enough} ya isa a {speed}. Dole jiragen ƙasa su ƙara nisa da juna, don haka kaɗan ne ke dacewa a awa. Sake saita alamomi, ko sanya alamar sashe a can.
rail.signal.removed_distant: An cire alamar nesa: jiragen ƙasa ba sa samun gargaɗi cewa babbar alamar gaba na iya nuna tsaya, don haka dole su kusanto ta a hankali isasshe don tsayawa da gani. Sake saita alamomi, ko sanya alamar nesa a nisan birki kafin ta.
rail.signal.removed_speed: An cire alamar gudu: ba a nuna saukar zuwa {speed} ba, don haka direba na iya shiga cikinta da sauri da yawa. Sake saita alamomi, ko sanya alamar gudu a can.
rail.signal.removed_starter: Babu alamar tashi a ƙarshen dogon dandamali: an cire wadda aka samar. Ba za a iya riƙe jiragen ƙasa a dandamali ba, don haka layin gaba ba shi da kariya. Sake saita alamomi, ko sanya babbar alama a ƙarshen dandamali.
rail.signal.removed_storage_exit: Babu alama a fitar dogon ajiya: an cire wadda aka samar. Jiragen ƙasan da aka ajiye a can ba su da alamar fita, don haka ba za su iya fitowa ba. Sake saita alamomi, ko sanya alamar tsarawa (shunting) inda dogon ajiya ke haɗuwa da layi.
rail.signal.splits_line: Alama {signal} tana raba layin, don haka jiragen ƙasa za su iya bin juna kusa-kusa kuma fiye za su dace a awa.
rail.signal.splits_line_blocks: Alama {signal} tana raba layin zuwa sassa na {behind} da {ahead}, don haka jiragen ƙasa za su iya bin juna kusa-kusa kuma fiye za su dace a awa.
rail.signal.train_reaches_back: Jirgin ƙasa {train} da ya tsaya a alama {signal} yana kaiwa baya cikin {area}, don haka yana toshe shi yayin da yake jira. Matsar da alamar gaba, ko cire ta.
rail.slip.lost_crossing: Makunnin zamewa ya rasa mahaɗarsa: dogayen da ke haɗuwa a can sun canza. Sake zaɓar makunnin zamewa a jerin mahaɗai.
rail.slip.main_line_element: {slip} abu ne na babban layi, ba a saba gina shi ga dogon {mode} ba.
rail.slip.needs_one_level: Makunnin zamewa yana buƙatar dogayen biyu su haɗu a mataki ɗaya.
rail.slip.needs_straight: {slip} yana buƙatar dogo madaidaici na {length} a kowane gefen mahaɗar. Matsar da lanƙwasa nesa da ita.
rail.slip.not_a_slip: {element} ba makunnin zamewa ba ne a kundin bayani.
rail.slip.one_system: {slip} yana haɗa dogayen tsarin layin dogo ɗaya; a nan {mode} yana ketare {other}.
rail.slip.single_tracks: {slip} yana haɗa dogaye guda-guda biyu. Inda dogaye biyu-biyu ke haɗuwa, yi amfani da mahaɗa biyu ko makunnin ketarewa (crossover) maimakon haka.
rail.slip.turn_between: {what} ({slip}): jiragen ƙasa za su iya juyawa tsakanin dogayen biyu a nan ma.
rail.slip.turn_between_speed: {what} ({slip}): jiragen ƙasa za su iya juyawa tsakanin dogayen biyu a nan ma a gudu har zuwa {speed}.
rail.slip.wrong_angle: An gina {slip} ne ga dogayen da ke haɗuwa a {ratio} ({angle}). Waɗannan dogaye suna haɗuwa a {actual_ratio} ({actual_angle}): canza kusurwar da ke tsakaninsu.
rail.station.platform_short: {station}: dandamali {platform} ya yi gajere ga jirgin ƙasa {train} tare da jurewar tsayawa ta {tolerance}.
rail.station.terminus_no_crossover_ahead: Ƙarshen gaba na {station} tashar ƙarshe ce ba tare da makunnin ketarewa a kusanci ba: jiragen ƙasa ba za su iya canza dogo don juyawa ba.
rail.station.terminus_no_crossover_rear: Ƙarshen baya na {station} tashar ƙarshe ce ba tare da makunnin ketarewa a kusanci ba: jiragen ƙasa ba za su iya canza dogo don juyawa ba.
rail.street.crosses_ramp: {name} yana ketare dogon a kan gangarensa, inda dogon ba ya matakin titi kuma bai yi zurfi ko tsayi isasshe don wucewa ta ƙasa ko ta sama da titin ba. Matsar da gangaren nesa da titin.
rail.street.cycle_angle: {name} yana ketare dogon a {angle}, mafi lebur fiye da {limit}: ƙafar keke na iya faɗawa cikin gibin da ke gefen dogo kuma mai hawa ya faɗi. Lanƙwasa hanyar don ta haɗu da dogon kusa da kusurwa madaidaiciya.
rail.street.flat_angle: {name} yana ketare dogon a {angle}, mafi lebur fiye da {limit}: mashigar tana da tsawo kuma direbobi ba sa iya gani a tsawon dogon. Ketare kusa da kusurwa madaidaiciya.
rail.street.how.barriers: shinge suna rufe titin {warning} kafin jirgin ƙasa ({distance} kafin mashigar a {speed})
rail.street.how.marked: mashiga da aka yi wa alama tare da allunan gargaɗi, inda mutane ke lura da tram
rail.street.how.path_gates: fitilu da ƙofofin masu tafiya da ƙafa ko jujjuyawa suna rufe hanyar {warning} kafin jirgin ƙasa
rail.street.how.traffic_signals: fitilun zirga-zirga suna tsayar da zirga-zirgar titi saboda tram
rail.street.level_crossing: Mahaɗar daidai da {name} a {angle}: {how}. Bas da sauran ababen hawan titi suna jira {distance} daga wurin mashigar kuma ba sa taɓa tsayawa a kan dogo.
rail.street.line_speed: Gudun layi a kan mahaɗar daidai da {name} shine {speed}, sama da iyakar da aka saba ta {limit}. Tana buƙatar cikakkun shinge tare da gano cikas da aka haɗa da alamomi, don jiragen ƙasa su tsaya yayin da mashigar ba ta share ba, ko ƙaramin gudu a can.
rail.street.mode_no_crossing_path: Dogon {mode} yana ketare {name} a mataki ɗaya. Layukan {mode} galibi ba su da mahaɗar daidai. Wannan tana buƙatar cikakkun shinge, gano cikas da kariyar jirgin ƙasa da ke tsayar da jiragen ƙasa yayin da mashigar ba ta share ba. Yi la'akari da gadar ƙafa ko hanyar ƙarƙashin ƙasa.
rail.street.mode_no_crossing_street: Dogon {mode} yana ketare {name} a mataki ɗaya. Layukan {mode} galibi ba su da mahaɗar daidai. Wannan tana buƙatar cikakkun shinge, gano cikas da kariyar jirgin ƙasa da ke tsayar da jiragen ƙasa yayin da mashigar ba ta share ba. Yi la'akari da wucewa da dogon ta ƙasa ko ta sama da titin.
rail.street.motorway: {name} babbar hanya ce (motorway), kuma manyan hanyoyi galibi ba su da mahaɗar daidai. Wannan tana buƙatar cikakkun shinge a kowane layin titi, gano cikas da allunan gargaɗi da alamomi tun da wuri kafin mashigar. Yi la'akari da gada.
rail.street.path_crossing: Mashigar hanya da {name} ga {users} a {angle}: {how}. Suna jira {distance} daga wurin mashigar.
rail.street.third_rail: Wannan dogo yana ketare {name} a mataki ɗaya da dogo na uku, wanda zai kasance da wuta inda ababen hawan titi da mutane ke ketarewa. Yana buƙatar gibi a dogo na uku a duk faɗin mashigar (jiragen ƙasa suna wucewa ba tare da ƙarfi ba) tare da ƙarshe masu keɓewa da shinge, ko wayar sama a wannan sashe.
rail.street.trolley_ac: Wayoyin bas mai waya a {name} ba za su iya ketare wayar sama ta layin dogo ({system}) ba: bas masu waya suna sauke sandunansu kuma suna ketarewa da batir a nan.
rail.street.trolley_dc: Wayoyin bas mai waya a {name} suna ketare wayar sama ta layin dogo ({system}): wannan yana buƙatar keɓaɓɓen mahaɗar wayoyin bas mai waya da na layin dogo.
rail.street.users.foot_cycle: masu tafiya da ƙafa da masu keke
rail.street_running.cyclists_rails: Masu keke a {name} suna hawa a tsawon dogayen tram: ƙafar da ta kama a kwazazzabo dalili ne da aka saba na faɗuwa. Layin keke a gefen dogo (shafin GIS) yana nisanta su daga dogayen.
rail.street_running.mixed_bus_narrow: a layukan zirga-zirga, tare da motoci da bas: faɗin titin kimanin {width} ne kuma layin tram tare da layukan titi a gefensa yana buƙatar {needed}
rail.street_running.mixed_bus_set: a layukan zirga-zirga, tare da motoci da bas (an saita a shafin GIS)
rail.street_running.mixed_main_road: Tram yana tafiya {length} a tsawon {name} {how}. A babban titi tram yana makale a cunkoson ababen hawa kuma zai iya tsayawa cak a cunkoso, don haka yana jinkiri (kimanin {delay} fiye a nan a lokacin cunkoso). Ba shi layinsa na kansa, wanda aka ware daga zirga-zirga, a shafin GIS (matsar da wurin ajiye mota ko layin titi), ko yi amfani da fitilun zirga-zirga da ke barin tram ya wuce farko.
rail.street_running.mixed_narrow: a layukan zirga-zirga, tare da motoci: faɗin titin kimanin {width} ne kuma layin tram tare da layukan titi a gefensa yana buƙatar {needed}
rail.street_running.mixed_set: a layukan zirga-zirga, tare da motoci (an saita a shafin GIS)
rail.street_running.own_lane: a layinsa na kansa ({width}), tare da layin titi a kowace hanya a gefensa
rail.street_running.own_lane_separated_s: a layinsa na kansa, wanda aka ware daga zirga-zirga (an saita a shafin GIS)
rail.street_running.own_lane_set: a layinsa na kansa (an saita a shafin GIS)
rail.street_running.painted_lane: Tram yana tafiya {length} a tsawon {name} {how}. Layin an fenta shi ne kawai, don haka motoci masu juyawa, masu ajiye mota da masu lodi har yanzu suna kawo cikas (kimanin {delay} fiye a nan a lokacin cunkoso); gefen titi ko gadon dogo daban (rabewa a shafin GIS) yana hana su shiga.
rail.street_running.painted_lane_limited: Tram yana tafiya {length} a tsawon {name} {how}, a gudu har zuwa {limit} (iyakar gudun titin). Layin an fenta shi ne kawai, don haka motoci masu juyawa, masu ajiye mota da masu lodi har yanzu suna kawo cikas (kimanin {delay} fiye a nan a lokacin cunkoso); gefen titi ko gadon dogo daban (rabewa a shafin GIS) yana hana su shiga.
rail.street_running.pedestrian_zone: ta cikin yankin masu tafiya da ƙafa
rail.street_running.runs_along_limited: Tram yana tafiya {length} a tsawon {name} {how}, a gudu har zuwa {limit} (iyakar gudun titin).
rail.street_running.stop_island: Tashar tram {stop} a {name} tana da dandamalin tsibiri a tsakiyar titi: fasinjoji suna kaiwa gare shi ta kan layukan titi, don haka yana buƙatar mashigar masu tafiya da ƙafa mai fitila a ƙarshensa.
rail.street_running.stop_kerb: Tashar tram {stop} a {name}: fasinjoji suna hawa daga gefen titi (tashar gefen titi), kuma zirga-zirgar titi tana jira a bayan tram yayin da yake tsaye a tasha.
rail.street_running.stop_platforms: Tashar tram {stop} a {name}: fasinjoji suna hawa daga dandamali a gefen dogaye.
rail.switch.built_with_legs: {switch}: an gina shi da {built} domin ƙafafun {chosen} ba za su iya haɗuwa a tazarar tsakiyoyin dogo ta {spacing} ba.
rail.switch.built_with_scissors: {switch}: an gina shi da {built} domin makunnan ketarewa biyu a jere da {chosen} ba su dace a dogo madaidaici a nan ba.
rail.switch.crossover_needs_double: Makunnan ketarewa (crossover) suna haɗa dogayen biyu na dogo biyu.
rail.switch.in_spread: {name} yana inda dogaye ke buɗewa zuwa dandamali. Matsar da shi zuwa inda dogayen ke tafiya kafaɗa da kafaɗa (parallel).
rail.switch.incomplete_geometry: {element} ba makunni ba ne mai cikakken siffa.
rail.switch.junction_needs_double: Mahaɗa biyu tana buƙatar dogo biyu.
rail.switch.on_curve: {name} yana kan lanƙwasa. Makunnan kundin bayani suna kan dogo madaidaici.
rail.switch.on_ramp: {name} yana kan gangare. Makunnai kada su kasance a kan canjin gangare ko lanƙwasar tsaye.
rail.switch.overlap: Makunnai biyu suna haɗuwa a kan juna. Matsar da ɗaya a tsawon dogo.
rail.switch.too_close: {name}: dogayen suna da nisa {spacing}, sun yi kusa da yawa don ƙafafun makunnan kundin bayani su haɗu. Yi amfani da makunni mafi lebur, ko faɗaɗa tazarar dogo.
rail.switch.unknown_element: Abin kundin bayani da ba a sani ba {element}.
rail.terrain.station_height: {station} yana daidaice tare da dogayensa a {rail} sama da matakin teku; ƙasar da ke tsawonsa tana tsakanin {low} da {high}.
rail.terrain.station_street_falls: {height} A matakin titi ƙasa tana faɗuwa {fall} a tsawon tashar, don haka dole a sake daidaita titin da ke kewaye da ita har zuwa {regrade}. Matsar da tashar zuwa ƙasa mafi lebur ko gina ta a sama ko ƙarƙashin ƙasa.
rail.terrain.steep_ground: Ƙasa tana da wannan gangare a nan. Canza matakin (a sama ko ƙarƙashin ƙasa) ko bi da dogon a tsawon gangaren. Tsayi suna zuwa daga samfurin saman ƙasa, don haka gine-gine da bishiyoyi na iya bayyana har yanzu.
rail.terrain.steep_tie_in: Wani ɓangare nasa yana zuwa ne daga haɗuwa da tasha a daidaice ko makunni a ƙarshen dogon; ba dogon ƙarin tsawo a can ko matsar da tashar.
rail.terrain.street_track_above: Dogon matakin titi yana tafiya har zuwa {height} sama da ƙasa a tsawon {length} don haɗuwa da tasha a daidaice ko makunni a ƙarshensa (jurewa {tolerance}). Dole a sake daidaita titin a nan; matsar da tashar ko canza matakin.
rail.terrain.street_track_below: Dogon matakin titi yana tafiya har zuwa {height} ƙasa da ƙasa a tsawon {length} don haɗuwa da tasha a daidaice ko makunni a ƙarshensa (jurewa {tolerance}). Dole a sake daidaita titin a nan; matsar da tashar ko canza matakin.
rail.terrain.track_climbs: Dogon yana hawa a gangare har zuwa {gradient} a tsawon {length} (km {from}–{to}); mafi girma shine {max}. {why}
rail.terrain.track_falls: Dogon yana sauka a gangare har zuwa {gradient} a tsawon {length} (km {from}–{to}); mafi girma shine {max}. {why}
rail.track.clearance: Dogayen hanyoyi biyu suna da nisa {distance} kawai; suna buƙatar aƙalla {needed} tsakanin tsakiyoyin dogo (alamar sarari).
rail.track.joins_other_gauge: {joins} Faɗin dogayen ya bambanta ({gauge} da {other_gauge} mm).
rail.track.joins_other_system_station: Wannan dogon {mode} yana haɗuwa da tashar {other}. Tsare-tsaren layin dogo ne daban; haɗa dogayen tsari ɗaya, ko bar su su ketare juna.
rail.track.joins_other_system_switch: Wannan dogon {mode} yana haɗuwa da makunnin {other}. Tsare-tsaren layin dogo ne daban; haɗa dogayen tsari ɗaya, ko bar su su ketare juna.
rail.track.lost_end: Wannan dogo ya rasa haɗin ƙarshensa (tashar ko dogayenta sun canza). Ja ƙarshen zuwa wurin haɗi.
rail.track.lost_start: Wannan dogo ya rasa haɗin farkonsa (tashar, dogayenta ko makunnin sun canza). Share shi ko sake zana shi.
rail.track.open_end: Ƙarshen dogo a buɗe. Haɗa shi da tasha ko makunni, ko saita dogon a matsayin dogon ajiya don ya ƙare a shingen ƙarshen dogo.
rail.track.open_start: Farkon dogo a buɗe. Haɗa shi da tasha ko makunni, ko saita dogon a matsayin dogon ajiya don ya ƙare a shingen ƙarshen dogo.
rail.track.storage_short: {name} yana ɗaukar {length}, gajere fiye da jirgin ƙasa {train} ɗaya.
rail.track.storage_short_unnamed: Dogon ajiya yana ɗaukar {length}, gajere fiye da jirgin ƙasa {train} ɗaya.
rail.track.through_station: Wannan dogo yana wucewa ta tasha {station} a mataki ɗaya. Haɗa shi da dogayen tashar, ko canza matakinsa.
street.depot.no_entrance_gate: Tashar ajiye ba ta da kofar shiga.
street.depot.no_exit_gate: Tashar ajiye ba ta da kofar fita.
street.depot.no_path: Babu hanya ta halal tsakanin tashar ajiye da wannan tashar ƙarshe.
street.depot.terminal_off_road: Tashar ƙarshe ba ta kan titin da ake iya amfani da shi.
street.line.beyond_battery: {length} ba tare da wayar sama ba ya wuce iya tafiyar batir ta {range}.
street.line.end_stops: Tashoshin ƙarshe sun fi biyu. Hanya tana da tashar ƙarshe ɗaya (layin zagaye) ko biyu (alƙiblu biyu); yi amfani da tsari (pattern) don gajerun juyawa.
street.line.mixed_traffic: Layin yana tafiya {length} a cikin zirga-zirgar manyan tituna: cunkoso da tsayawa cak suna riƙe bas, kimanin {delay} a kowane zagaye a lokacin cunkoso, kuma suna jinkiri. Ba waɗannan tituna layin bas a shafin GIS, wanda aka ware daga zirga-zirga don hana motoci shiga.
street.line.mixed_traffic_along: Layin yana tafiya {length} a cikin zirga-zirgar manyan tituna ({streets}): cunkoso da tsayawa cak suna riƙe bas, kimanin {delay} a kowane zagaye a lokacin cunkoso, kuma suna jinkiri. Ba waɗannan tituna layin bas a shafin GIS, wanda aka ware daga zirga-zirga don hana motoci shiga.
street.line.mixed_traffic_along_more: Layin yana tafiya {length} a cikin zirga-zirgar manyan tituna ({streets} da ƙarin {more}): cunkoso da tsayawa cak suna riƙe bas, kimanin {delay} a kowane zagaye a lokacin cunkoso, kuma suna jinkiri. Ba waɗannan tituna layin bas a shafin GIS, wanda aka ware daga zirga-zirga don hana motoci shiga.
street.line.no_legal_path: Babu hanya ta halal: tituna masu hanya ɗaya, hana juyawa ko iyakokin ababen hawa suna toshe ta, kuma bas ba za su iya juyawa U ba. Matsar da wuri ko sanya tashar ƙarshe inda abin hawa zai iya juyawa (tashar bas, madauki, kewaye).
street.line.no_road_near: Babu titin da wannan abin hawa zai iya amfani da shi a cikin {distance}.
street.line.not_on_road: Ba ya kan titin da ake iya amfani da shi.
street.line.on_battery: Yana tafiya {length} da batir ba tare da wayar sama ba.
street.line.red_legs: Ba za a iya tuƙa wasu ɓangarori ba; duba ɓangarorin ja.
street.line.turning_detour: Juyawa yana ƙara {extra} ({length} maimakon {direct}). Yi la'akari da sanya tashar ƙarshe inda abin hawa zai iya juyawa: tashar bas, madaukin juyawa, kewaye ko unguwar da zai iya zagayawa.
street.line.two_stops: Layi yana buƙatar aƙalla tashoshi biyu. Mai da wurare zuwa tashoshi.
street.line.wrong_side: Wannan ɓangare yana da {length} ga {straight} a layi madaidaici. Idan wuri na gaba yana kan ɗayan rabin titi mai rabewa, ko a titi mai hanya ɗaya a alƙibla mara kyau, matsar da shi zuwa gefen da abin hawa ke tuƙi.
street.line.wrong_sidewalk: Ba za a iya hidimar wannan gefen titi ba: zirga-zirga a nan tana tafiya ne kawai tare da tashar a ɗayan gefe daga ƙofofi. Sanya tashar a ɗayan gefen titi.
